function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web. Returns up to 8 results as title, URL and snippet.

function.name: read_web_page
function.description: Fetch a public web page (GET only) and return its readable text.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file from the project workspace (/data/workspace).

function.name: write_file
function.description:
Write a text file into the project workspace (/data/workspace). Creates folders.
    Files starting with a #! line are made executable.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files in the project workspace.

function.name: run_script
function.description:
Run a Python (.py) or shell (.sh) script from the workspace with a 120s timeout.
    Network access only through the egress proxy. Returns exit code and output.
